<noinclude>
Stores and displays one OpenAlex field and lists its subfields. Written by the upload bot
between the <code>BOT:BEGIN openalex</code> and <code>BOT:END openalex</code> markers.

{{#cargo_declare:_table=Fields
|openalex_id=String
|name=String
|description=Text
|domain=Page
|domain_id=String
|works_share=Float
|citations_share=Float
|works_permille=Float
|works_count=Integer
|cited_by_count=Integer
|wikipedia=URL
|wikidata=String
}}
</noinclude><includeonly>{{#cargo_store:_table=Fields
|openalex_id={{{openalex_id|}}}
|name={{{name|}}}
|description={{{description|}}}
|domain={{{domain|}}}
|domain_id={{{domain_id|}}}
|works_share={{{works_share|}}}
|citations_share={{{citations_share|}}}
|works_permille={{{works_permille|}}}
|works_count={{{works_count|}}}
|cited_by_count={{{cited_by_count|}}}
|wikipedia={{{wikipedia|}}}
|wikidata={{{wikidata|}}}
}}<div style="font-size:90%; margin-bottom:0.5em;">[[{{{domain}}}]] › '''{{{name}}}'''</div>
{| class="wikitable" style="float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 1em 1em; width:22em;"
! colspan="2" style="font-size:110%;" | {{{name}}}

{{{description|}}}

== Subfields ==
{{#cargo_query:tables=Subfields
|fields=_pageName=Subfield,works_share=Share of works (%),citations_share=Share of citations (%)
|where=field_id='{{{openalex_id}}}'
|order by=works_share DESC
|format=table
|limit=500
|default=''No subfields stored yet.''
}}
